name: Ultrasound Denoising Segmentation Benchmark
evaluation_method: PSNR, SSIM (for denoising); Dice, IoU, F1 (for segmentation)
reputation: A research-grade public dataset that has modest adoption in ultrasound imaging research for benchmarking denoising and segmentation methods.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; likely limited dataset size and acquisition-specific characteristics that can limit generalization; risk of overfitting to the provided scans.
